Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo invite — guests can't see join details

Hi Sofia / Ben,

Thanks for scheduling the GTM Labs demo for tomorrow. I accepted the calendar invite but my team reports that the event shows as "Guests cannot see event details" in Google Calendar: there is no visible join link or host contact. We've seen this before when calendar organizer settings strip the event body for external domains.

Screenshot attached (screenshot-guest-view.png). Can you reissue a meeting with a visible join link (Zoom would be fine) or confirm the passcode? We need to share the link internally at our company. If possible please avoid forwarding the original invite (we lose the attendee RSVP history).

Appreciate a quick fix — we prefer to keep the same time if possible.

Thanks,
Kai Morgan

Ben / Hannah — tagging you. Kai shows the typical "Guests cannot see event details" issue; likely organizer is the original creator in our GSuite and external guest visibility is restricted. Two quick options:

1) Create a brand-new Zoom meeting owned by Ben (or me) and send a fresh invite to kai.morgan@tideway.ai and all attendees. Keeps details visible.
2) Try to transfer organizer rights for the existing GCal event to Ben so the body unblocks for external guests — this sometimes works but can be flaky cross-domain.

Ben, can you create a Zoom meeting and send a calendar event you own? Hannah, if Ben needs admin help claiming organizer rights I can open a support ticket. Keep the time the same (tomorrow 11 Jan, 10:00-10:45am PT).
